newsitem.title: USA: Security Capital Atlantic in $56 mln stock swap.
newsitem.headline: Security Capital Atlantic in $56 mln stock swap.

text.p: Security Capital Atlantic Inc said on Monday that it has unanimously approved an agreement with Security Capital Group Inc to exchange Security Capital Group's REIT management and property management companies for $54.6 million of Atlantic common stock.
As a result of the transaction, SC Atlantic will become an internally managed real estate investment trust, with SC Group continuing as its largest shareholder.
Based on SC Atlantic's 1997 forecast, the company said the transaction will be immediately accretive to its per share funds from operations.

Under the terms of the agreement, SC Atlantic and SC Group said that they have agreed the number of shares issued to SC Group will not exceed a maximum of 2.6 million shares (equivalent to $20.64 per share) or fall below a minimum of 2.1 million shares (equivalent to $25.86 per share).
The parties expect the transaction to close in the third quarter of 1997, subject to approvals.
